title: How $32 Billion Vanished Overnight 📉

scenes.line: $32 billion vanished in days, but the real crime happened behind closed doors.
In November 2022, crypto exchange FTX faced a sudden liquidity crisis.
Auditors found billions in customer funds were secretly misused by Alameda Research.
Founder Sam Bankman-Fried was convicted of massive fraud.
Bankruptcy plans claim some customers may get paid back, but $32 billion vanished in days.

description: In November 2022, crypto exchange FTX collapsed, wiping out $32 billion in value and leading to major fraud convictions. Discover the true story behind one of history's largest financial disasters.
pinned: Do you think retail customers will ever fully recover their funds?
